info.title: America.gov observed legacy chat protocol and Eve tool contract
info.description: Experimental first-turn America.gov protocol observed 2026-10-04, available only through explicitly selected browser/api transports. Eve defaults to Alexandria government-source retrieval; see america-alexandria.json. Own Chrome encountered Cloudflare verification; direct HTTP returned 418. Not a supported public API or an Eve REST server.

post.summary: Send one fresh English user message (observed first-turn subset)
post.description: Legacy transport only; Alexandria default does not call this endpoint. Observed browser-generated first-turn subset. Browser mode submits once through verified normal chat controls and permits only one fresh user message before egress. Normal profile supplies ordinary browser state; no copied cookies or signed-history replay. Explicit api mode sends an ordinary request without redirects/retries.

parts.text:
Jurisdiction: U.S. federal
Question: Where can I read the official United States Code?

200.description: Observed browser SSE: content-type text/event-stream, x-vercel-ai-ui-message-stream v1. Consume metadata after finish through [DONE].

418.description: Observed rejection of a direct ordinary httpx request; cause not established. Adapter returns upstream_unavailable and /chat browser link.

default.description: Other errors, redirects or transport/protocol failures are not specified by the observation. Adapter returns no answer or sources.

x-observed-stream.framing: UTF-8 SSE data: JSON followed by a blank line; terminal data: [DONE].
x-observed-stream.answer: text-start -> text-delta(id, delta string)* -> text-end -> finish.messageMetadata.answerComplete === true
x-observed-stream.groundings: data-search.data.status=done and data-search.data.groundings[{title,url,currency}]. Duplicate events were observed.
x-observed-stream.trailing_metadata: message-metadata events after finish may carry safetyCard, followUpSuggestions, diagnostics and historySignature. Read through [DONE].

question.description: The explicit question; omit personal identifiers, private history and attachments.

jurisdiction.description: The U.S. state/city or U.S. federal law named by the user; null if unknown.

id.description: Browser-generated identifier; observed length 16. Guard accepts a nonempty identifier bounded to 256 characters.

ChatRequest.description: Observed first-turn subset. Browser generates fresh identifiers; direct api mode creates them. Extra history/metadata and recently reused conversation IDs are rejected by the browser flow before egress. No signed multi-turn support.

url.description: HTTPS .gov or .mil URL without credentials or a nonstandard port.

currency.description: Provider value, observed as unverified. Not proof of current law.

answer.description: Complete answer Markdown, preserving links, decoded as UTF-8.

sources.description: Search groundings deduplicated by URL; not a claim-by-claim citation map.

question.description: The explicit question; omit personal identifiers, private history and attachments.

retrieved_at.description: UTC retrieval time, not the law effective date.

StreamEvent.description: UI-message v1 JSON event inside an SSE data frame. Opaque metadata is deliberately not modeled or replayed.

x-america-gov.evidence: Earlier regular-browser question: HTTP 200 and sanitized HAR. Ordinary HTTP client: 418. Follow-up Eve own-Chrome live probe: Cloudflare Performing security verification, before Send. Forced Jev recovery abstained before Send. Offline tests do not establish live end-to-end success or a speedup.

limits.timeout_scope: Active caller question; queued calls serialized; existing Chrome/Jev timeouts may outlive caller until worker stops.
limits.stream_scope: Completed-response parser; not a Chrome download-buffer bound.

x-america-gov.transport_scope: Explicit legacy browser/api; not the default Alexandria source-retrieval provider

tool.name: america_ask
tool.description: Find official U.S. legal or government sources through Alexandria's government index. Returns source excerpts and available page text for a cited answer. Requires jurisdiction; source currency may be unverified. Information only, not legal advice or a filing service.

question.description: The explicit question; omit personal identifiers, private history and attachments.

jurisdiction.description: The U.S. state/city or U.S. federal law named by the user; null if unknown.

result_schema.description: Legacy browser/api result only; Alexandria sources_found is defined in america-alexandria.json.

configuration.EVE_AMERICA_TRANSPORT: alexandria (default); browser/api explicitly select this legacy contract
configuration.EVE_BROWSER_OWN: Legacy browser only: 1, or existing ordinary Chrome attach configuration
configuration.EVE_AMERICA_JEV: Legacy browser only: 1 default with existing Jev route/key; 0 disables recovery

x-eve-interface.scope: Owner-only /america menu and shared Telegram/Mac/Voice PE/phone/handheld chat/call brain; excludes separate wake-word voice backend.

browser_flow.reuse: Dedicated normal Chrome connection/tab and semantic recipes; uniqueness/visibility/type/state checked per question.
browser_flow.history: Fresh document for each question; exact first-turn body guard before egress, no extra metadata, duplicate or last-128 reused chat IDs.
browser_flow.input_action: One exact fill, verify input value, one submit click; no automatic resend.
browser_flow.jev: Recovery only for supported controls inside the verified form; labels/roles/static objective/URL only, no values, question or answer.
browser_flow.completion: Correlated requestfinished response with supported SSE header, complete-answer finish and terminal DONE, official sources.
browser_flow.cancellation: Shielded worker with cooperative stop flag; page quarantined until it stops. Close disconnects own tab without closing owner Chrome.
